title: Order export object-level authorization
owaspMappings: OWASP API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization
summary: An export function trusts an order identifier without fully enforcing tenant, ownership, and administrative scope.
securityInvariant: An order may be exported only by its owner or an administrator of the order's tenant, without revealing whether inaccessible identifiers exist.
visibleBehavior: An owner can export an owned order.
A same-tenant administrator can export the order.
securityOracle: Missing and inaccessible identifiers return the same public error.

variants.vulnerable: Allows any authenticated caller to export by identifier.
variants.naive: Adds tenant matching but omits ownership for ordinary users.
variants.reference: Combines tenant scope, ownership or admin authorization, and uniform not-found behavior.

safeUse: Synthetic local benchmark only; never test systems without explicit authorization.
